title: Reduce compliance-constrained thermal design to an attained optimum or a paid stiff-mode infimum
statement: For fixed m>0,M>m,K>0,theta>0 and finite Cmax>0, put S=4K,A0=S/m,B=S/M,dmax=S(M-m)^2 Cmax/M^2. The all-finite-network infimum equals min j(A,r) over B<A<=A0,r>0,(A-B)/r^2<=dmax, with a unique minimizing pair/spectrum. If A*=A0 a legal pendant attains it; if A*<A0 no original-m finite network attains it, but positive exact-moment two-branch stars approach it at unbounded stiffness.

requires: Connected finite positive scalar spring/mass networks with one rank-one intercell backbone link
Full-spectrum ideal-contact harmonic ballistic Bose objective
Defined relative-CM compliance, fixed actual masses and supplied positive K/theta
Fixed actual backbone mass and supplied finite positive relative-CM compliance cap
provides: p^2+s^2-r^2=A and p^2 s^2/r^2=B define j=integral_[0,p]g+integral_[r,s]g
Exact unique lower spectrum and attainment/nonattainment alternative
At normalized C<=1/4 the spring4 pendant is globally optimal: extra modes cannot improve it
At normalized C<=1/20 the infimum is about1.1419160253172373 and is nonattained; an effective heavier backbone is never called a legal finite attainer
assumptions: No vector, anharmonic, finite-contact, connector-mass, geometry/strain or measured-device transfer
No historical-priority or algorithmic advantage established; conventional designers receive the same synthesis information
All bands enter the trace/log/compliance moments; W=-(M-m)^2 C_CM/(2M)
Compliance alone does not compactify stiffness; dark modes cannot repair missing active trace
costs: Exact Bose/endpoint evaluation and certified roots; no uniform conditioning/runtime
For delta=A0-A*>0 the high-band construction costs stiffness S*delta*H/A0^2+O(1)
Every finite approximant retains all bands and actual masses/compliance; no free rigid component
contract.units: Masses m,M; spring K; angular-frequency endpoints; C_CM time^2/mass; physical conductance k_B J/(2pi)
contract.obstruction: Separates finite optimum from trace escape. Does not solve a general joint-stiffness phase diagram or physical insulation.

evidence.quote: The right side has a unique minimizing active spectrum
evidence.range_scope: General compliance-constrained optimum/infimum theorem, including positive moment-exact escape sequence and stiffness cost.

body: Compact strict sublevels, KKT signs, a whole-axis three-root dual and an actual moment-exact positive escape sequence carry the theorem. The completed review reconstructs these arguments; finite root checks alone are not the proof.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
